author: Kilat Fitzgerald
title: MN fraud: Day care owner, Feeding Our Future defendant pleads guilty to wire fraud and conspiracy
supports: Contemporaneous federal-court reporting states that Fahima Egeh Mahamud pleaded guilty on July 9, 2026 to wire fraud and conspiracy to defraud the United States.

The report states that prosecutors attributed more than $4.6 million in false Child Care Assistance Program claims and approximately $850,000 in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds to the conduct resolved by the plea.
The report states that court documents showed a plea-agreement guideline range of 27 to 33 months, while making clear the sentencing judge retained final sentencing authority.
does_not_support: A scheme-wide Feeding Our Future conviction ordinal for Mahamud; the article reports the plea but does not establish DOJ's counting convention.
A final sentence; sentencing was still pending at publication.
Primary judicial proof of the plea; the plea agreement, change-of-plea minute, and judgment remain preferred sources when captured.
